customRules.title: Broad Express CORS policy
customRules.detail: Wildcard or credentialed broad CORS can expose API responses to unintended browser origins.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Restrict origins to known clients and add a CORS regression check.

customRules.title: Express auth bypass-shaped change
customRules.detail: Auth bypass flags can make protected API routes public by accident.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Confirm the route is intentionally public and add an authorization test.

customRules.title: Raw SQL from request input
customRules.detail: Request-controlled values flowing into raw query execution can become SQL injection.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Use parameterized queries or a query builder, then add an injection-focused test.
